Vietlook Travel will share with you the complete and most concise Thai Nguyen travel guide, please refer to it to have the most enjoyable tour.

Coming to Thai Nguyen, tourists will visit famous attractions such as: Tan Cuong Tea Hill, Nui Coc Lake, Hang Pagoda, or visit Linh Son Cave, or go boating on Che Rapid Lake, and experience the unique culture, so let’s follow Vietlook Trave to fully explore the beauty of Thai Nguyen right below.

Thai Nguyen Climate

Thai Nguyen has a hot and humid tropical monsoon climate, and is divided into four distinct seasons, and each region of Thai Nguyen has a different climate, the highest temperature usually falls in June.

The festivals in Thai Nguyen mainly take place in January, including traditional festivals and spiritual beliefs such as Duom Temple Festival, Long Tong Festival, Hich Festival, Hang Pagoda Festival, Van Mountain – Vo Mountain Festival. If you travel to Thai Nguyen in the summer, visitors will admire the cool green tea hills, and enjoy the famous Sane specialty.

When traveling to Thai Nguyen, you should choose to stay at hotels in Thai Nguyen City such as Habana, Da Huong, May Plaza, Dong Duong, Hai Au, The King Hotel, with prices ranging from 400,000 to more than 1 million VND per night.

In addition, if you travel to Thai Nguyen on your own with a group of friends, you can choose to camp overnight at Mojen’s Camp & Retreat stream, to enjoy the peaceful space that this place brings to visitors.

Thai Nguyen tourist attractions you should know.

Nui Coc Lake

A place likened to an oasis, including many small islands such as Nui Cai Island, Hoa Island, Co Island, Long Hoi Island, visitors can experience on basket boats, and visit mysterious caves, visit Thieng Thac Vang Pagoda…

Ghenh Che Lake

As an eco-tourism destination, visitors can experience fishing here, a very suitable place for weekend picnics, visitors can camp right next to the lake to feel the peaceful beauty.

Kem Stream and La Bang Tea Area

Coming here, visitors will encounter rocky cliffs, clear streams, and follow the cliffs with the cool water pouring down from above like a love song in the middle of the mountains and forests, and freely take virtual photos next to the lush green tea hills.

Phuong Hoang Cave – Mo Ga Stream

Phoenix Cave is associated with legendary stories, the cave mouth from the top of the mountain, the cave’s heart goes deep into the mountain, from the cave entrance runs down to form a small waterfall, in addition, when coming here, visitors can also experience swimming pool services, motels for visitors to stay.

Hang Pagoda

Located about 2 km from the center of Thai Nguyen city, where there are caves and steep cliffs, inside the cave there are stalactites… surrounded by beautiful natural scenery creating a peaceful beauty.

Duom Mountain – Duom Temple

From afar, the rocky mountain looks like a dragon’s head, the cliffs are vertical, covered with ancient moss, at the foot of the mountain is a temple to worship famous businessmen, Duom Temple has been ranked as a national monument in 1993, here also takes place the Duom Temple festival every January.

ATK Dinh Hoa National Special Relic Site

During the resistance war against French colonialism (1946 – 1954), Dinh Hoa, Dai Tu and Phu Luong districts were chosen as the Central Security Zone (ATK) military zone. Dinh Hoa ATK Dinh Hoa is ranked as a national monument. When coming here, visitors should visit Khau Ty hill – the place where President Ho Chi Minh’s first working headquarters was located at ATK Dinh Hoa, and the office of General Secretary Truong Chinh at Na Mon hill, Phong Tuong hill, where President Ho Chi Minh awarded the rank of General to the Commander-in-Chief of the Vietnam Army Vo Nguyen Giap, ATK Dinh Hoa exhibition house, President Ho Chi Minh memorial house, Uncle Ho’s hut in Khuon Tat, Quang village relic, Bao Bien relic, Cho Chu prison…

Museum of Vietnamese Ethnic Cultures

As a large-scale cultural project, visitors will be able to visit 40,000 original documents and artifacts about the traditional culture of 54 Vietnamese ethnic groups, in the exhibition rooms, introducing ethnic cultures divided by different languages ​​such as: Viet – Muong, Tay – Thai, Mong – Dao, Mon – Khmer, Nam Dao and Han…

Delicious dishes in Thai Nguyen

Thai Nguyen is not only famous for its famous landscapes but also known for its delicious dishes such as: Banh tro, Xoi ngu sac, Nham, Banh cooc mo, Com lam Dinh Hoa, Banh wormwood… and many more delicious and attractive dishes waiting for tourists to discover.

So, let’s join Vietlook Travel on the Cao Bang – Thai Nguyen tour today to experience the most interesting things that this place brings to visitors, hopefully this article will help you in some way on your trip.
